from tests.clihelp import BookTestCase, run, subprocess_run

TRY = "Try 'tallybook --help'."


class UsageTests(BookTestCase):
    def test_exit_2_shapes(self):
        cases = [
            [],
            ["bogus"],
            ["account"],
            ["account", "nope"],
            ["account", "add"],
            ["account", "add", "A", "B"],
            ["account", "list", "--bogus"],
            ["account", "list", "--type"],
            ["account", "list", "--json", "--json"],
            ["account", "list", "--type", "asset", "--type", "asset"],
            ["account", "list", "--json=1"],
            ["account", "list", "--typ", "asset"],
            ["account", "list", "--today", "2024-01-01"],
            ["calc"],
            ["calc", "money"],
            ["import", "f.csv"],
            ["import", "f.csv", "--profile", "a", "--profile-file", "b"],
            ["tx", "add"],
        ]
        for argv in cases:
            with self.subTest(argv=argv):
                status, out, err = self.tb(*argv)
                self.assertEqual((status, out), (2, ""))
                lines = err.split("\n")
                self.assertTrue(lines[0].startswith("tallybook: "), err)
                self.assertEqual(lines[1:], [TRY, ""])
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(self.db))

    def test_global_option_errors(self):
        for argv in (["--db"], ["--db", "a", "--db", "b", "init"], ["--version=1"], ["--bogus", "init"], ["-5", "init"]):
            with self.subTest(argv=argv):
                status, out, err = run(*argv)
                self.assertEqual((status, out), (2, ""))
                self.assertTrue(err.endswith("\n" + TRY + "\n"))

    def test_today_checked_first(self):
        status, out, err = run("--today", "2024-02-30", "--bogus", "init")
        self.assertEqual((status, out), (1, ""))
        self.assertIn("2024-02-30", err)
        self.assertEqual(err.count("\n"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(run("--today", "2024-02-29", "--bogus")[0], 2)

    def test_version_and_help(self):
        self.assertEqual(run("--version"), (0, "tallybook 1.0.0\n", ""))
        status, out, err = run("--help")
        self.assertEqual((status, err), (0, ""))
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith("usage: tallybook"))
        for words in ("init", "db backup", "serve", "account close", "tx delete", "query", "export", "journal import",
                      "import", "profile show", "rules set", "rate remove", "budget status",
                      "recurring materialize", "report register", "calc money parse"):
            self.assertIn(words, out)
        self.assertEqual(run("-h"), run("--help"))
        for line in out.split("\n"):
            self.assertEqual(line, line.rstrip())

    def test_group_and_command_help(self):
        status, out, _ = run("account", "--help")
        self.assertEqual(status, 0)
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith("usage: tallybook account"))
        for word in ("add", "list", "show", "close"):
            self.assertIn(word, out)
        status, out, _ = run("account", "add", "--help")
        self.assertEqual(status, 0)
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith("usage: tallybook account add PATH"))
        self.assertEqual(run("tx", "list", "-h")[1].split("\n")[0], "usage: tallybook tx list [--query QUERY] [--limit N] [--offset N] [--json]")
        self.assertEqual(run("calc", "-h")[0], 0)

    def test_help_is_a_value_when_consumed(self):
        self.seed()
        self.ok("account", "add", "Assets:Odd", "--note", "--help")
        self.assertIn("note: --help", self.ok("account", "show", "Assets:Odd"))

    def test_missing_book_and_env(self):
        err = self.fail("tx", "list")
        self.assertEqual(err, "tallybook: no such database: %s (run `tallybook init`)\n" % self.db)
        status, out, err = run("tx", "list", env={"TALLYBOOK_DB": self.db})
        self.assertEqual((status, out), (1, ""))
        self.assertIn(self.db, err)
        env_db = os.path.join(self.dir, "env.db")
        self.assertEqual(run("init", env={"TALLYBOOK_DB": env_db}), (0, "created %s (version 4)\n" % env_db, ""))
        self.assertEqual(run("init", env={"TALLYBOOK_DB": ""}, stdin="")[0], 0)
        os.remove("tallybook.db")

        self.assertIn("note: -5\n", self.ok("account", "show", "Assets:Cash"))
        self.assertIn("note:\nbalance", self.ok("account", "show", "Assets:Empty"))
        self.ok("account", "add", "Assets:Eq", "--note=a=b")
        self.assertIn("note: a=b\n", self.ok("account", "show", "Assets:Eq"))
        out = self.ok("tx", "add", "--date", "2024-04-01", "-p", "Assets:Cash -5.00 USD", "-p", "Assets:Bank 5.00 USD", "--", "-x")
        self.assertEqual(out, "added transaction 3\n")
        self.assertIn('"-x"', self.ok("tx", "show", "3"))
        out = self.ok("tx", "add", "-", "--date", "2024-04-02", "-p", "Assets:Cash -1.00 USD", "-p", "Assets:Bank")
        self.assertEqual(out, "added transaction 4\n")
        self.assertIn('"-"', self.ok("tx", "show", "4"))
        for argv in (["tx", "show", "-abc"], ["tx", "list", "--limit", "-1"], ["tx", "list", "--query", "-abc"],
                     ["tx", "add", "P", "-p", "-abc"], ["tx", "add", "-x", "-p", "A", "-p", "B"]):
            with self.subTest(argv=argv):
                err = self.fail(*argv)
                self.assertNotIn("unknown option", err)
                self.assertEqual(err.count("\n"), 1)

        self.seed()
        for text in ("+5", "1.5", "1e3", "abc", "", "1" * 19, " 1", "١"):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                self.fail("tx", "list", "--limit", text)
                self.fail("tx", "show", text)
        self.assertEqual(self.tb("tx", "list", "--limit", "9" * 18)[0], 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.tb("tx", "list", "--offset", "000")[0], 0)

        self.assertIn("missing.txt", err)
        err = self.fail("rules", "set", "-", stdin=b"\xff")
        self.assertIn("standard input", err)
        self.fail("rules", "set", self.dir)

    def test_posting_forms(self):
        self.seed()
        for posting, shown in (
            ("Expenses:Food   3.00  USD;n1", ["  Expenses:Food  3.00 USD  ; n1"]),
            ("Expenses:Food 3.00 USD ;  spaced ; more ", ["  Expenses:Food  3.00 USD  ; spaced ; more"]),

        ):
            with self.subTest(posting=posting):
                out = self.ok("tx", "add", "P", "--date", "2024-05-01", "-p", posting, "-p", "Assets:Bank", "--json")
                tx = json.loads(out)
                self.assertEqual(tx["postings"][1]["amount"], {"amount": "-3.00", "currency": "USD"})
                shown_text = self.ok("tx", "show", str(tx["id"]))
                self.assertIn(shown[0], shown_text)
        for bad in ("", "  ", "Expenses:Food 3.00", "Expenses:Food 3.00 USD extra", "Expenses:Food 3.005 USD",

            with self.subTest(bad=bad):

    def test_python_dash_m(self):
        done = subprocess_run("--version")
        self.assertEqual((done.returncode, done.stdout, done.stderr), (0, b"tallybook 1.0.0\n", b""))
        done = subprocess_run("--db", self.db, "init")

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import unittest

from tests.clihelp import BookTestCase

LIST_TABLE = (
    "Id  Date        Flag  Payee   Narration  Tags\n"
    "--  ----------  ----  ------  ---------  -----\n"
    " 1  2024-01-01  *     Opening\n"
    " 2  2024-03-02  *     Market             #food\n"
)
SHOW_2 = (
    "; id 2\n"
    '2024-03-02 * "Market" #food\n'
    "  Expenses:Food   42.50 USD  ; veg\n"
    "  Assets:Bank    -42.50 USD\n"
)


class DbTests(BookTestCase):
    def test_init_variants(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("init"), "created %s (version 4)\n" % self.db)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("init"), "%s is up to date (version 4)\n" % self.db)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("db", "version"), "4\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("db", "migrate"), "database is up to date (version 4)\n")
        empty = self.write("empty.db", b"")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("--db", empty, "init") if False else self.ok_with(empty, "init"), "migrated %s from version 0 to 4\n" % empty)
        junk = self.write("junk.db", "not a database")
        self.assertIn("tallybook:", self.on(junk, "init", fail=True))
        with open(junk) as handle:
            self.assertEqual(handle.read(), "not a database")

    def ok_with(self, db, *argv):
        from tests.clihelp import run

        status, out, err = run("--db", db, *argv)
        self.assertEqual((status, err), (0, ""))
        return out

    def on(self, db, *argv, fail=False):
        from tests.clihelp import run

        status, out, err = run("--db", db, *argv)
        self.assertEqual((status, out), (1, ""))
        return err

    def old_book(self, version):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db)
        conn.executescript(
            "CREATE TABLE accounts (path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, type TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT, opened TEXT,"
            " note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');"
            "CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date TEXT NOT NULL, payee TEXT NOT NULL,"
            " narration TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', cleared INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);"
            "CREATE TABLE postings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
            " tx_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,"
            " seq INTEGER NOT NULL, account TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(path),"
            " minor INTEGER NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL);"
            "PRAGMA user_version = %d;" % version
        )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

    def test_old_book(self):

import json
import unittest

from tests.clihelp import BookTestCase, run

PROFILE = (
    "date_column = Date\npayee_column = Payee\namount_column = Amount\ncurrency = USD\n"
    "account = Assets:Bank\ndefault_account = Expenses:Misc\n"
)
STATEMENT = "Date,Payee,Amount\n2024-03-01,Shop,-5.00\n2024-03-02,Cafe,-3.00\n"


class ImportTests(BookTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.seed()
        self.ok("account", "add", "Expenses:Misc", "--currency", "USD")
        self.profile = self.write("bank.profile", PROFILE)
        self.statement = self.write("march.csv", STATEMENT)

    def test_profiles(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "list"), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "list", "--json"), "[]\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "add", "bank", self.profile), "stored profile bank\n")
        self.ok("profile", "add", "alpha", self.profile)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "list"), "alpha\nbank\n")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.ok("profile", "list", "--json")), ["alpha", "bank"])
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "show", "bank"), PROFILE)
        self.write("nonl.profile", PROFILE.rstrip("\n"))
        self.ok("profile", "add", "nonl", self.write("nonl.profile", PROFILE.rstrip("\n")))
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "show", "nonl"), PROFILE)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "remove", "alpha"), "removed profile alpha\n")
        self.refuse("profile", "remove", "alpha")
        self.refuse("profile", "show", "alpha")
        self.refuse("profile", "add", "bad name", self.profile)
        self.refuse("profile", "add", "worse", self.write("bad.profile", "currency = USD\n"))
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "add", "-", "-", stdin=PROFILE) if False else "", "")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("profile", "add", "piped", "-", stdin=PROFILE), "stored profile piped\n")

    def test_import_and_duplicates(self):
        self.ok("profile", "add", "bank", self.profile)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("import", self.statement, "--profile", "bank"), "imported 2 transactions, 0 duplicates\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("import", self.statement, "--profile", "bank"), "imported 0 transactions, 2 duplicates\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("import", self.statement, "--profile-file", self.profile), "imported 0 transactions, 2 duplicates\n")
        shown = self.ok("tx", "show", "3")
        self.assertIn('2024-03-01 * "Shop"', shown)
        self.assertIn("Expenses:Misc", shown)
        self.ok("tx", "delete", "3")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("import", "-", "--profile", "bank", stdin=STATEMENT), "imported 1 transactions, 1 duplicates\n")

    def test_rules_and_no_rules(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "show"), "")
        rules = self.write("rules.txt", '# food\nwhen payee ~ "shop" then account Expenses:Food tag shop\n\nwhen any then flag !\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "set", rules), "stored 2 rules\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "show"), '# food\nwhen payee ~ "shop" then account Expenses:Food tag shop\n\nwhen any then flag !\n')
        self.ok("profile", "add", "bank", self.profile)
        self.ok("import", self.statement, "--profile", "bank")
        shown = self.ok("tx", "show", "3")
        self.assertIn('2024-03-01 * "Shop" #shop', shown)
        self.assertIn("Expenses:Food", shown)
        self.assertIn("2024-03-02 ! \"Cafe\"", self.ok("tx", "show", "4"))
        self.ok("tx", "delete", "3")
        self.ok("tx", "delete", "4")
        self.ok("import", self.statement, "--profile", "bank", "--no-rules")
        self.assertIn("Expenses:Misc", self.ok("tx", "show", "5"))
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "set", self.write("none.txt", "")), "stored 0 rules\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "show"), "")
        err = self.refuse("rules", "set", self.write("bad.txt", "when payee ~ x then flag !\n"))
        self.assertTrue(err.startswith("tallybook: line 1: "), err)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "set", "-", stdin="when any then flag !"), "stored 1 rules\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rules", "show"), "when any then flag !\n")

    def test_bad_rows_import_nothing(self):
        self.ok("profile", "add", "bank", self.profile)
        bad = self.write("bad.csv", "Date,Payee,Amount\n2024-03-01,Shop,-5.00\n2024-13-01,Cafe,-3.00\n2024-03-03,Pub,1.505\n")
        err = self.refuse("import", bad, "--profile", "bank")
        lines = err.split("\n")
        self.assertEqual(lines[0], "tallybook: 2 rows could not be imported, nothing was imported")
        self.assertTrue(lines[1].startswith("row 3: ") and "2024-13-01" in lines[1])
        self.assertTrue(lines[2].startswith("row 4: ") and "1.505" in lines[2])
        self.assertEqual(lines[3:], [""])
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("db", "info").count("transactions: 2"), 1)
        err = self.refuse("import", self.write("nohead.csv", "Foo,Bar\n1,2\n"), "--profile", "bank")
        self.assertIn("Date", err)
        self.refuse("import", self.statement, "--profile", "missing")
        self.refuse("import", self.statement, "--profile-file", self.write("badp.txt", "nonsense\n"))
        self.refuse("import", self.dir + "/absent.csv", "--profile", "bank")
        self.refuse("import", self.statement, status=2)


class RateTests(BookTestCase):
    def test_rates(self):
        self.ok("init")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rate", "list"), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rate", "set", "USD", "EUR", "0.92", "--on", "2024-03-01"), "set 1 USD = 0.92 EUR on 2024-03-01\n")
        self.ok("rate", "set", "EUR", "JPY", "160.5", "--on", "2024-03-02")
        self.ok("rate", "set", "USD", "EUR", "0.9200", "--on", "2024-03-01")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.ok("rate", "list"),
            "From  To   Date        Rate\n"
            "----  ---  ----------  --------\n"
            "EUR   JPY  2024-03-02     160.5\n"
            "USD   EUR  2024-03-01    0.9200\n".replace("--------", "------").replace("     160.5", "  160.5").replace("    0.9200", "  0.9200"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(self.ok("rate", "list", "--json")),
            [{"from": "EUR", "to": "JPY", "date": "2024-03-02", "rate": "160.5"},
             {"from": "USD", "to": "EUR", "date": "2024-03-01", "rate": "0.9200"}],
        )
        self.refuse("rate", "set", "USD", "USD", "1", "--on", "2024-03-01")
        self.refuse("rate", "set", "USD", "EUR", "0", "--on", "2024-03-01")
        self.refuse("rate", "set", "USD", "EUR", "-1.5", "--on", "2024-03-01")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("rate", "remove", "USD", "EUR", "--on", "2024-03-01"), "removed rate USD -> EUR on 2024-03-01\n")
        self.refuse("rate", "remove", "USD", "EUR", "--on", "2024-03-01")
        status, out, err = run("--db", self.db, "--today", "2024-04-05", "rate", "set", "GBP", "USD", "1.25")
        self.assertEqual((status, out, err), (0, "set 1 GBP = 1.25 USD on 2024-04-05\n", ""))
        status, out, err = run("--db", self.db, "--today", "2024-04-05", "rate", "remove", "GBP", "USD")
        self.assertEqual((status, out, err), (0, "removed rate GBP -> USD on 2024-04-05\n", ""))


class BudgetTests(BookTestCase):
    def test_budget_flow(self):
        self.seed()
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("budget", "list"), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("budget", "list", "--json"), "[]\n")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.ok("budget", "add", "Expenses:Food", "400.00 USD", "--start", "2024-01-01"),
            "added budget Expenses:Food 400.00 USD per month\n",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.ok("budget", "list"),
            "Pattern        Per    Amount      Start\n"
            "-------------  -----  ----------  ----------\n"
            "Expenses:Food  month  400.00 USD  2024-01-01\n",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(self.ok("budget", "list", "--json")),
            [{"pattern": "Expenses:Food", "period_kind": "month", "amount": {"amount": "400.00", "currency": "USD"},
              "start": "2024-01-01"}],
        )
        self.refuse("budget", "add", "Expenses:Food", "1.00 USD")
        self.refuse("budget", "add", "Expenses:Food", "0.00 USD", "--per", "year")
        self.refuse("budget", "add", "Expenses:Food", "5.00 USD", "--per", "week")
        self.refuse("budget", "add", "Expenses:Food", "5 USD extra")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.ok("budget", "status", "--period", "2024-03"),
            "Pattern        Per    Budget      Actual     Remaining   Percent  Over\n"
            "-------------  -----  ----------  ---------  ----------  -------  ----\n"
            "Expenses:Food  month  400.00 USD  42.50 USD  357.50 USD    10.6%\n",
        )
        self.ok("budget", "add", "Expenses:Food", "10.00 USD", "--per", "year", "--start", "2024-01-01")
        rows = self.ok("budget", "status", "--period", "2024-03").splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(rows[2].split()[-1], "10.6%")
        self.assertEqual(rows[3].split()[:2] + rows[3].split()[-1:], ["Expenses:Food", "year", "over"])
        lines = json.loads(self.ok("budget", "status", "--period", "2024-03", "--json"))
        self.assertEqual([(ln["period_kind"], ln["over"]) for ln in lines], [("month", False), ("year", True)])
        self.assertEqual(lines[0]["percent"], "10.6")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("budget", "status", "--period", "2023-06"), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("budget", "status", "--period", "2023-06", "--json"), "[]\n")
        status, out, _ = run("--db", self.db, "--today", "2024-03-20", "budget", "status")
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines()[2].split()[3:5], ["400.00", "USD"])
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("budget", "remove", "Expenses:Food"), "removed budget Expenses:Food per month\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("budget", "remove", "Expenses:Food", "--per", "year"), "removed budget Expenses:Food per year\n")
        self.refuse("budget", "remove", "Expenses:Food")
        self.refuse("budget", "status", "--period", "2024-3")


class RecurringTests(BookTestCase):
    def add_rent(self):
        return self.ok(
            "recurring", "add", "rent", "monthly on 1", "Landlord", "--start", "2024-01-01", "--count", "5",
            "--narration", "Rent", "--tag", "home", "-p", "Expenses:Food 10.00 USD", "-p", "Assets:Bank",
        )

    def test_add_list_remove(self):
        self.seed()
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("recurring", "list"), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("recurring", "list", "--json"), "[]\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.add_rent(), "added recurring rent\n")
        self.refuse("recurring", "add", "rent", "daily", "X", "-p", "A", "-p", "B")
        self.refuse("recurring", "add", "bad", "sometimes", "X")
        self.refuse("recurring", "add", "bad", "daily", "X", "--count", "0")
        self.refuse("recurring", "add", "bad", "daily", "X", "--count", "-1")
        self.refuse("recurring", "add", "bad", "daily", "X", "--start", "2024-01-05", "--end", "2024-01-01")
        rows = self.ok("recurring", "list").splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(rows[0].split(), ["Name", "Schedule", "Start", "End", "Count", "Through", "Payee"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[2].split(), ["rent", "monthly", "on", "1", "2024-01-01", "5", "Landlord"])
        data = json.loads(self.ok("recurring", "list", "--json"))
        self.assertEqual(data[0]["template"]["tags"], ["home"])
        self.assertEqual(data[0]["template"]["postings"][1], {"account": "Assets:Bank", "amount": None, "note": ""})
        self.assertEqual(
            {k: data[0][k] for k in ("name", "schedule", "start", "end", "count", "materialized_through")},
            {"name": "rent", "schedule": "monthly on 1", "start": "2024-01-01", "end": None, "count": 5,
             "materialized_through": None},
        )
        self.assertEqual(data[0]["template"]["payee"], "Landlord")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("recurring", "remove", "rent"), "removed recurring rent\n")
        self.refuse("recurring", "remove", "rent")

    def test_materialize(self):
        self.seed()

        self.assertIn("2024-05-01", self.ok("recurring", "list"))
        self.assertEqual(self.ok("recurring", "materialize", "--upto", "2025-01-01"), "created 0 transactions\n")

    def test_invalid_template_stores_nothing(self):

                "-p", "Expenses:Nowhere 1.00 USD", "-p", "Assets:Bank")
